description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)] if 0-3/4+ FF4 allies are alive, grants [Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [Airship Tech's Forte Follow-Up] to the user if 4+ FF4 allies are alive

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], [Imperil Water 10% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 10% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)]

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 20% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 20% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 20% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 20% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 20% (15s)], [Imperil Water 20% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 20% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 20% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 20% (15s)]

description.name: Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Airship Tech's Forte Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Airship Tech's Forte four times after using Spark Break three times
